dedupe_keys.name: reedd cr one minute household electricity and appliance signatures

description: REEDD-CR contains whole-home and branch-circuit electricity measurements from fifty-one Costa Rican households. EPERLab monitored each participating household at one-minute resolution for at least one week and identified circuits by their principal end uses. The deposit also includes 197 appliance signatures, with seven demand and consumption features for eight appliance classes, plus the underlying single-appliance measurements. Mendeley provides CSV files free under CC BY 4.0. Homes were distributed across Costa Rica, but participation depended on residents’ willingness and availability, so the sample is not established as nationally representative. Short household monitoring windows do not provide a common annual time series or complete seasonal coverage. A reviewer-assessed use is constructing appliance-demand components or testing disaggregation assumptions in residential electricity simulations. data-refit-smart-homes-uk offers related household monitoring data from a different country. No measurements were downloaded, and household or appliance definitions were not harmonized between the collections.
